references.name: Claude Shannon
references.desc:
Father of information theory, co-built the
first wearable computer with Thorp, intellectual
kindred spirit

references.name: Warren Buffett
references.desc:
Met 1968, contrasting investment philosophies,
Berkshire Hathaway one of Thorp’s best
long-term holdings

references.name: Nassim Nicholas Taleb
references.desc:
Wrote the foreword, champions Thorp as the
first successful quantitative risk-taker

references.name: Beat the Dealer
references.desc:
1962 bestseller that launched the card counting
revolution

references.name: Beat the Market
references.desc:
1967 book on warrant hedging, precursor to
Black-Scholes

references.name: John Kelly
references.desc:
Bell Labs physicist, 1956 Kelly Criterion paper
on optimal bet sizing

references.name:
Fischer Black &
Myron Scholes
references.desc:
Published the option pricing formula Thorp had
already discovered and was trading on

references.name: Richard Feynman
references.desc:
Met at a party, discussed roulette physics,
inadvertently encouraged Thorp’s research

references.name: Benjamin Graham
references.desc:
Buffett’s mentor, value investing
pioneer, "cigar butt" metaphor

references.name: Robert Shiller
references.desc:
Home price data showing only 0.4% real
annual returns 1890–2004

references.name: Eugene Fama
references.desc:
Efficient market hypothesis, the "$100 bill
on the ground" parable

references.name: Bill Sharpe
references.desc:
CAPM creator, Sharpe’s Principle on why
most active investors trail the index

references.name: Adam Smith
references.desc:
Invisible hand metaphor, discussed in context
of its limitations

references.name: John Maynard Keynes
references.desc:
"Markets can remain irrational longer than you
can remain solvent"

references.name: Fortune’s Formula
references.desc:
Covers overlapping story of Shannon, Kelly,
Thorp, and the mob

references.name: Thomas Malthus
references.desc:
Geometric vs. arithmetic growth, cited in
compound interest discussion

references.name: Garrett Hardin
references.desc:
Tragedy of the commons, applied to
overfishing and pollution

references.name: Connie Bruck
references.desc:
Master of the Game, revealed Manny
Kimmel’s mob background

references.name: Vilfredo Pareto
references.desc:
Power law distribution of wealth, applied to
American wealth statistics
